{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Dragon Magazine'' Annual #6}}
'''''Dragon Magazine'' Annual #6''' is the {{Link |url=https://ia903109.us.archive.org/8/items/DragonMagazine260_201801/Dragon%20Magazine%20Annual%206%2C%202001.pdf |text=2001 Christmas special issue}} of ''[[wikipedia:Dragon Magazine|Dragon Magazine]]'' which contains various ''Wheel of Time'' material:[[File:Dragon Magazine Annual 6, 2001 cover.png|thumb]]

* ''[[Beasts of the Wheel of Time]]'', an article written by [[Robert Jordan]] on the flora and fauna of the [[Westlands]]
* non-canon ''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]'' hero templates by Owen K.C. Stephens:
** "Latent Channelers" ([[Wilder]]s)
** [[peddler]]s
** [[Saldaean]] scouts
** "Seductresses" ([[Domani]] noblewoman)
** [[Younglings]]
** [[Windfinder]] [[Apprentice]]s
